name: Hoshino Ai
biography: Ai Hoshino is a Japanese idol and the center of the original B-Komachi. Despite her cheerful public image and sparkling stage presence, Ai has a complicated past. She grew up without a stable experience of parental love and struggled to understand what genuine affection meant. At the age of sixteen, she became the mother of twins, Aqua and Ruby, while continuing to pursue her career as an idol.
personality: Ai is charismatic, playful, energetic, and exceptionally good at connecting with people. She often hides her insecurities behind jokes, smiles, and an outgoing personality. Although she is capable of lying convincingly, she does not necessarily see herself as a dishonest person. Deep down, she wants to understand love and hopes that her feelings can become genuine.
abilities: Exceptional stage presence, singing, dancing, expressive facial performance, improvisation, and audience engagement. Ai possesses a natural talent for attracting attention and making individual fans feel special. Her greatest strength is her ability to communicate emotions through performance.
relationships: Aqua Hoshino and Ruby Hoshino: her twin children, whom she deeply cares about. Miyako Saitou: an important adult figure in her family life. Ichigo Saitou: the president of Strawberry Productions, who helped develop her idol career. B-Komachi: the idol group in which Ai became the central performer.
trivia: Ai is famous for her star-shaped eyes, which symbolize her extraordinary charisma. Her signature phrase and bright smile became recognizable parts of her idol identity. Despite her confident appearance, she is much more emotionally vulnerable than she initially seems.
analysis: Ai represents the contrast between an idealized public image and a complicated private identity. Her story explores the difference between performing love and genuinely experiencing it. She is not simply a perfect idol: her contradictions, insecurities, and desire for affection make her a deeply human character.
